# Colorado Athletics Foundation (COAF)

> A 501(c)(3) / 509(a)(2) public charity in Aurora, Colorado (EIN 93-1548121) that funds access to youth and adult athletics across the Denver metro area: scholarships, program fees, equipment, and training, so income never decides who gets to play.

Mission: accessibility, diversity, and opportunity through athletics, regardless of experience or income, with a focus on youth, women, and minority communities.

Contact: info@coloradoaf.org · 14200 E Alameda Ave, Aurora, CO 80012

## Programs

- [Youth volleyball](https://coloradoaf.org/youth-volleyball.html): scholarships toward club fees, training, travel, and gear for a partner youth volleyball program (Colorado Boom).
- [Youth basketball](https://coloradoaf.org/youth-basketball.html): funded roster spots and training access in a supported youth basketball program (Team EVO).
- [Community fitness](https://coloradoaf.org/community-fitness.html): COAF's own low-cost, scholarship-supported adult fitness and athletics program in Aurora.

## Key pages

- [About](https://coloradoaf.org/about.html): history, what COAF funds, and how it operates.
- [Scholarships](https://coloradoaf.org/scholarships.html): eligibility and application; rolling review, the board typically responds within 10 business days.
- [Donate](https://coloradoaf.org/donate.html): how gifts are used; donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.
- [Impact](https://coloradoaf.org/impact.html): why athletics access matters and what COAF reports.
- [Board](https://coloradoaf.org/board.html): operations board and fundraising board.
- [Contact](https://coloradoaf.org/contact.html)
